providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Manage Claude Code / Desktop third-party API configs and switch with one click
providers.codeSubtitle: Manages only Claude Code (~/.claude/settings.json) third-party configuration
providers.desktopSubtitle: Manages only Claude Desktop (configLibrary) third-party configuration
providers.fromPresetPlaceholder: Pick a built-in preset to autofill
providers.keyStored: The key is stored in the system credential manager; leave this blank to keep it.
providers.requiredBaseUrl: Please enter an API base URL
providers.missingKey: This provider has no API key yet — edit it to add one before switching
providers.empty: No third-party providers for this application; official login is the default

proxy.title: Local Proxy
proxy.description: Claude Desktop can reach non-Anthropic providers through this proxy. It starts automatically when you switch to a provider using the local-proxy protocol.

mcp.title: MCP Servers
mcp.description: Manage MCP servers for Claude Code and Claude Desktop in one place. Saving or toggling a server synchronizes its target configuration after a backup.
mcp.confirmDelete: Delete this MCP server? It will also be removed from enabled application configurations.
mcp.empty: No MCP servers yet. Import existing configuration or add one manually.
mcp.requiredConfig: Please enter the server JSON configuration
mcp.invalidConfig: Server configuration must be a JSON object
mcp.configHelp: Enter the JSON value under mcpServers for this server, such as command/args or URL configuration.
mcp.syncNote: Saving replaces only the mcpServers section in each selected application's configuration; all other settings are preserved.

prompts.title: Prompts / CLAUDE.md
prompts.description: Manage reusable CLAUDE.md instruction presets. The current live file is backed up before activation.
prompts.activated: Activated {{name}} and wrote it to live CLAUDE.md
prompts.renameUnsupported: Renaming is not supported yet. Create a new preset, then remove the old one.
prompts.activationNote: Activation replaces ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and creates a backup first.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Request, token, and estimated-cost data from local-proxy logs. Only proxied requests are logged; streaming token usage is updated once the response completes.
usage.name: Name
usage.noData: No proxy request logs in this period
usage.noPricing: No model pricing yet; costs are calculated as $0
usage.integrityFailed: Database integrity check failed; restore from a backup

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Manage local Claude Code Skills. Only public GitHub repositories and local ZIP archives are accepted; a package must include SKILL.md.
skills.githubHelp: Enter a public GitHub repository URL, such as https://github.com/owner/repository.
skills.zipHelp: Enter the full local path to a ZIP file. The archive must include SKILL.md.
skills.name: Name
